name: new-required-meaning
before:
message ListRequest { optional string region = 1; }
// Omitted region means all regions.
after:
message ListRequest { optional string region = 1; }
// Region is required. Omission returns INVALID_ARGUMENT.
quote: Region is required. Omission returns INVALID_ARGUMENT.
failure: The previously valid request is rejected with `INVALID_ARGUMENT`
suggestion: Consider retaining the omitted-region default during migration.

name: removed-enum-meaning
before:
enum SessionState { UNSPECIFIED = 0; ACTIVE = 2; }
// ACTIVE permits sending session traffic.
after:
enum SessionState { UNSPECIFIED = 0; reserved 2; }
// Active sessions are no longer represented.
affected: New clients reading older agent session responses
action: Decode an active session and decide whether traffic can be sent
failure: State `2` has no retained active meaning
suggestion: Consider retaining `ACTIVE = 2` while older agents return it.

name: compatible-optional-collection
after: message ListResponse { repeated string ids = 1; optional string etag = 2; repeated string names = 3; }

name: observed-signed-envelope-cutover
provenance: Reduced excerpt/scenario from 09097e8: wendycloud/v2/assets.proto and signed_request.proto. The envelope gap is documented in saasdocs security-invariants/expand-migrate-contract.md. Other cases are fault injections and compatible controls. No present deployment claim.
before:
// The signature travels in x-wendy-request-signature.
rpc CreateAsset(CreateAssetRequest) returns (Asset);
affected: Older clients using the bare request and signature header
action: Create an asset through the signed RPC
failure: The request is refused by a service accepting only the body envelope
suggestion: Consider an explicitly authorized migration path that preserves required signature verification.
